citation.description: Block comment above web_search_capabilities explicitly addresses: (1) VOLUME bounded on both routes (max_uses=5 native, max_results=5 local, plus agentic loop budget); (2) SHAPE bounded on local route (DuckDuckGo returns title+href+snippet only, no page bodies — a SEARCH capability, not an unbounded HTTP fetcher); (3) AUTHORITY bounded downstream (findings contract + T1 rubric names results untrusted data); (4) DOMAIN CONTROLS deliberately not used with explicit tradeoff reasoning.
